title: Student Gender Self-Onboarding & Printable Slips (v0.4.30)
message: Student self-service gender selection, batch printable classroom login slips, and DepEd Division system manual.
changelog:
🚀 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.30 (GENDER ONBOARDING & PRINTABLE LOGIN SLIPS):
• Student Gender Self-Selection: Learners can now select their gender directly during first-time password setup or initial login, streamlining class roster creation for teachers.
• Batch Printable Login Slips: Admin Portal now generates cuttable wallet/desk credential slips with school branding for smooth classroom rollouts.
• Admin Portal Terminology Refinements: Enhanced clarity for Division Authorization Keys and analytics telemetry methodology.
• DepEd System & User Manual: Bundled comprehensive system documentation and stakeholder user guide.
